module_summary: 8-to-16-bit width converter: a toggling phase flag latches the first valid byte, then concatenates it with the second byte and pulses valid_out.

anchors.name: flag
anchors.why: Two-state byte phase toggled per valid_in; selects latch first byte vs emit word.

anchors.name: data_lock
anchors.why: Holds the first byte until the second arrives; upper half of data_out.

anchors.name: valid_in
anchors.why: Input byte valid; toggles flag and enables latch/output updates.

anchors.name: data_in
anchors.why: 8-bit input byte, latched or concatenated into data_out.

anchors.name: valid_out
anchors.why: One-cycle valid pulse when a 16-bit word is assembled.

groups.name: phase_control
groups.description: Toggle flag tracking first/second byte phase.

groups.name: width_packer
groups.description: Byte holding register and 16-bit concatenation with valid pulse.
